bonding_required.quote: The board shall require every wholesale distributor applying for a license to submit a bond of at least one hundred thousand dollars, or other equivalent means of security acceptable to the board, such as an irrevocable letter of credit or a deposit in a trust account or financial institution

drug_authority.value: Wholesale distributors may distribute prescription drugs (including biological products) to licensed entities; they may not dispense pursuant to prescriptions, which is excluded from the definition of distribution.
